Paths._comment_backupRoot: Pre-format workstation backups now land under Workstation\Systems\<pcname>, alongside the rest of the Workstation folder tree, instead of a separate D:\WorkstationBackups.

_comment_departments: Salary and Purchase were separate groups/shares before - consolidated into ONE share (SalaryWagesPurchase$, matching the old server's real single folder), with two subfolders inside it (Purchase, Salary Wages) for people who should only see their own slice. SalaryWagesPurchase group members (full access) see both; Purchase/SalaryWages group members see only their own subfolder - access-based enumeration hides the other one from them entirely, it doesn't just deny opening it.
_comment_printers: Only network printers belong here. The Brother is the one shared printer - everyone gets it (empty Groups = everyone) and it is their default. IPAddress is used by 'Install a network printer on the server'; Path is what workstations connect to once it is shared. The IP plan records .50 as the intended static address, but notes the printer may still be on DHCP at .191 - confirm before deploying. The USB printers (HP LaserJet Tank MFP 260x on Gokul, HP LaserJet Professional M1136 MFP on Rahul, Canon LBP2900 on Priyanka and on Supriya, HP LaserJet Pro P1100 Plus on Prakash) are deliberately NOT listed: they are USB-attached to one PC each, have no network address, and Windows installs them locally when plugged in. Nothing to deploy centrally.

Branding._comment_quotes: Shown under 'Quote of the Day' on the login splash. One is picked per day, the same one for everyone that day, cycling through the list. Keep them short - long lines are shrunk to fit, but under about 55 characters looks best. Rerun the branding option after editing.
Branding._comment: LoginSplash.png is the background only - the employee's real name is drawn on top live at logon by Show-LoginSplash.ps1, using SplashFontTtf so it doesn't need the font installed on the workstation.

Workstation._comment: One 'Workstation' AD group covers this whole tree (all Users are members). Layout: D:\Domech\Workstation\Personal\<username> - each user's own share, mapped to P: for them only, with Desktop/Documents/Downloads/Pictures redirected there. D:\Domech\Workstation\Systems\<pcname> - per-PC data (pre-format backups etc, see Paths.BackupRoot), admin-only, not user-mapped.

_comment_wingetApps: Microsoft.Office is Microsoft 365 Apps - roughly 4GB per machine, so restart workstations a few at a time rather than all at once. It is skipped automatically on any machine that already has Office, so an existing install is never overwritten. TallyPrime is deliberately absent: it has no winget package and is installed by hand.
